sources.title: Project: Constructing an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) | City of Irvine
Pre-Approved ADU Development Standards Checklist (Form 67-01, Rev 01/25)
Building Permit Requirements Under Assembly Bill (AB) 2234 | City of Irvine

passages.excerpt: A completed Residential Accessory Dwelling Unit (RADU) application and ADU Verification Form are required for all ADU and JADU projects.
ADU Verification Form (contact the Planning Team at planning@cityofirvine.org
Building plans, calculations, and construction documents
Development Standards Checklist for Site Plan
Covenant (obtain copy from Planning at planning@cityofirvine.org. Document will need to be notarized; recorded with County of Orange Recorder’s office when notified by case planner)
Your application package must be submitted online using the IrvineReady! Online Permit Submittal Portal.
After submitting your plans, City staff will review the information for completeness within approximately two business days. If additional information is needed, you will be notified.
You will be emailed a link to pay required fees.
After payment is received, your project will be processed for review.
Refer to Government Code section 65852.2 subdivisions (d)(1-5) and j(10) for more information.
passages._review_note: needs_review: copied from PDF text extraction; confirm against the visible PDF page before publishing.

passages.excerpt: AB 2234 also requires jurisdictions to determine whether a post-entitlement phase permit application is completed within 15 days of receiving the application, requires project review to be complete within 30 days for projects 25 units or fewer, and 60 days for projects 26 units or more.
passages._review_note: needs_review: confirm wording on the live page; this describes a state law (AB 2234), not an Irvine ADU-specific service target.

conflicts.summary: Spec §8 lists plan review before fee/payment readiness. The city's ADU page says fees are paid after the completeness check and the project is processed for review only after payment. This draft orders fee payment before plan review; team to confirm.

Stale citation: Form 67-01 (Rev 01/25) refers applicants to Government Code section 65852.2 for ADU parking. State ADU law was renumbered to Gov Code 66310-66342 (HCD ADU Handbook). Mapping to the new section is unknown until checked; do not substitute a number.
